title: Drop a job lock's key into a group lock box and add your padlock
instruction: Take the key hanging beside the PUMP 1 panel (yellow nameplate) and drop it into the red lock box through the key slot in its lid. Then hang your purple padlock through a free hole of the box's front flange to the right of the yellow padlock, and snap it shut. Do not move the yellow padlock or the other key.
context: In group lockout the keys of all job locks go into one lock box and every worker hangs a personal padlock on it, so no key can come out, and no machine can be restarted, until the last worker has removed their lock. Dropping in the wrong key, or a padlock that does not actually hold the lid, defeats it.
setup: Positions are measured forward from the line joining the two arm bases (61 cm apart), left or right of their midline as seen from behind the robot, and up from the table top. Lock box: a Master Lock S601 group lock box (red powder-coated stainless steel; body 27.2 cm long, 12.8 cm deep, 14.4 cm tall with its lid; 2.5 kg) stands on a grey steel block (15.2 x 29.2 x 5.5 cm), its long side facing the robot: body centre 32 cm in front of the bases and 6 cm left of the midline. Its lid is hinged at the left end and latched at the right end. Along both long sides the lid's flange lies on the body's flange (each 1.75 cm wide, their top 17.6 cm above the table) with nine numbered holes through both (taken as 11 x 14 mm, 2.8 cm apart, centres 0.9 cm out from the wall); on the front, hole 5 is centred 6 cm left of the midline and hole 1 is at the left (hinge) end. A key slot (4.0 x 0.7 cm) crosses the lid 2.5 cm from its right end. Coworker's lock: a yellow Master Lock 410YLW Zenex padlock (body 38 x 19 x 44 mm, 6.35 mm steel shackle, 38 mm vertical clearance, 100 g) with a red danger tag, locked through front hole 5. Panels: a plywood board (1.8 cm thick, 22 cm tall) stands on the table with its front face 37 cm in front of the bases, from 9.5 to 45 cm right of the midline. On it two grey pump starter panels (7 cm wide, 7 cm deep, 13 cm tall, bottom 3 cm above the table): PUMP 1, centred 13 cm right of the midline, with a yellow engraved nameplate (6.4 x 2.4 cm), and PUMP 2, centred 33 cm right, with a white one. Each has a black rotary handle at OFF with a red Master Lock 410RED job padlock on it, and on its right side a 4 mm steel peg, 7 cm long, 12 cm above the table and 0.8 cm behind the panel's front, on which hangs the brass key of that panel's job lock (52 mm long, bow 22 mm wide, 2.3 mm thick, 7 g) by its bow hole, 6 cm out from the panel. Robot's lock: a purple Master Lock 410PRP of the same size, open (shackle popped up 16 mm), standing upright on a grey column (3.0 x 0.9 cm, 13.5 cm tall, on a 6 x 5 x 1 cm foot) 19 cm in front of the bases and 12 cm left of the midline, its short leg toward the box. Both arms start at the ready pose with their grippers open. One fixed layout, as in the screenshot.
scoring: Score 0 if PUMP 2's key ever leaves its peg (moves more than 2 cm), or if the yellow padlock moves more than 1 cm before the purple shackle is shut. Otherwise the score is the highest level reached: 0.25 if PUMP 1's key has moved 2 cm or more from its peg; 0.5 if that key is inside the lock box; 0.75 if, with the key inside, the purple padlock's short leg also passes through a free hole of the lid's flange and the body's flange under it; 1.0 if the purple shackle is also shut (latched) through such a hole and the after-release check passes. After-release check, done once both grippers have been at least 6 cm from the purple padlock for 2 s: remove the yellow padlock, release the latch and lift the lid's free (right) end with 20 N on a spring scale for 2 s. Pass if the lid opens less than 15 degrees (its right end rises less than 7 cm) and the key is still inside; if not, the score stays at 0.75.
reset_notes: Open the purple padlock with its key and take it off the box; stand it back open on its column, short leg toward the box. If the yellow lock was removed for the check, lock it back through front hole 5. Open the box (latch, then lid), take out PUMP 1's key and hang it back on PUMP 1's peg (and PUMP 2's on its own peg if moved); close and latch the lid. About 2 minutes.
fidelity: PhysX rigid bodies on joints, arms with the station's i2rt gains. The lockout is geometry: a shackle through a lid-flange hole and the body-flange hole under it stops the hinged lid; the key falls through a gap in the lid. Inferred: hole, slot, flange sizes; pegs; panels. Simplified: latch is a joint limit; slot has no gasket and no key cup; box colliders; the 410 latches by a catch, no key; coworker lock rigid; check forces applied in sim after recording. Details in README.
